workers.request: goal/task/attempt identity, revisions, cwd, objective, scope, verification
workers.allowed: read files, search, inspect Git, strictly read-only commands
workers.forbidden: writes, mutations, completion claims, budget/revision changes
workers.host_authority: parse identity, persist evidence, transition, invoke Verifier
workers.transport_retry: non-mutating transport interruption is transport budget only

workers.allowed: read files, search, inspect Git, strictly read-only commands, propose exact WRITE_UTF8 operations
workers.forbidden: direct writes, mutating commands, host mutation claims, Task/Goal completion claims
workers.output: candidate_complete|blocked|needs_replan|failed plus bounded evidence and exact preimage-bound WRITE_UTF8 proposals
workers.host_authority: scope/preimage validation, mutation, postimage/evidence, Reviewer, Verifier
workers.transport_retry: only before mutation with conclusively absent side effects
workers.side_effect: before mutation None/ConfirmedNotPerformed; after mutation ConfirmedPerformed or Unknown
workers.restart: never replay unknown side effects; verify performed mutations before continuation

workers.request: identity/revisions, host-observed writer summary and file snapshots
workers.forbidden: workspace mutation, unrequested inspection, completion authority
workers.output: identity/revisions, summary, scalar blocking_findings, bounded evidence
workers.host_authority: parse review, enforce ReviewGate, transition to VERIFYING/BLOCKED

workers.request: full durable Goal/task/evidence/blocker snapshot and eligible NEEDS_REPLAN IDs
workers.allowed: monotonic task/dependency/verification/mandatory/criterion additions and direct prerequisite resolution
workers.forbidden: deletion, history rewrite, weakening, budget replenishment, execution/publication
workers.output: strict additive proposal with exact EXISTING/NEW refs
workers.host_authority: schema/identity/DAG/revision/plan revision validation and durable commit

workers.forbidden: model or worker completion authority, evidence invention
